I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for **185 seats**.

- **Where it came from:** On 2025-08-20 in #north-team (a channel Dana is in), she posted 180 seats for the amendment, which was signed 2025-08-19. A few minutes later she corrected it to 185. A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
- **Not checked against the document:** I couldn't open the signed amendment. I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to double-check before the QBR.
- **Similar name:** I warned her that Quarendon Freightways is a different company, not a Pemberline customer, so it shouldn't end up in the deck.
- **gbrain didn't work:** It refused the search because its connection isn't tied to a specific member, so nothing came back from it. I answered from the channels and files Dana can see instead. To fix it, whoever runs the gbrain server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>` there.
